title: Derived exchange on canonical single-module comparisons
statement: Choose shared derived categories of scheme modules [def-pc-derived-category]. Let f:X→S, f′:X′→S′, g:S′→S and p:X′→X be scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme], with pf=f′g. Let M be any X-module. Write c_k(N) for canonicalSinglePullbackMap [lem-pc-canonical-single-pullback-comparison], u_k(N) for canonicalSingleDirectImageMap [lem-pc-canonical-single-direct-image-comparison], t_k for the unique adjunction-preserving isomorphism from tensorPullback k to ordinary pullback k [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], B_M for moduleBaseChangeMap [lem-weil-pbc-module-base-change-map-open-restriction], and β for the pinned derived exchange [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. Then Lg*(u_f(M)) ≫ β(M[0]) ≫ Rf′*(c_p(M)) = c_g(f_*M) ≫ (t_g(f_*M)⁻¹ ≫ B_M ≫ f′_*(t_p(M)))[0] ≫ u_f′(p*M). No flatness, acyclicity, cartesianness or invertibility of a single-module comparison is assumed; the equation also holds for zero modules and empty schemes.

source.place: Tag 08HY, mate construction and derived unit compatibility

proof.text: Apply derivedBaseChange_unit_compatibility to the homotopy single of M. Precompose with Lg* of the localized inverse single-map comparison for f pushforward and postcompose with Rf′* of the localized single-map comparison for p tensor pullback and the single of t_p.

Naturality of the selected left-derived counit moves the first single comparison to its source; naturality of the right-derived unit moves the second to its target. Single-map comparisons intertwine the termwise exchange with the single of ordinary exchange. In degree zero this is the defining single-object identification; in other degrees the source is zero. Apply the homotopy quotient and localization to that identity, cancel t_g followed by its inverse, and reassociate. These are naturality, functoriality and single-complex identities and require no geometric hypotheses.

lean.statement:
theorem canonicalSingleBaseChangeComparison
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (p : X' ⟶ X)
    (h : p ≫ f = f' ≫ g) (M : X.Modules) :
    (derivedPullback g).map (canonicalSingleDirectImageMap f M) ≫
      schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g p h
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M) ≫
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map (canonicalSinglePullbackMap p M) =
    canonicalSinglePullbackMap g ((pushforward f).obj M) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace)) 0).map
        (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).leftAdjointUniq
          (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g)).inv.app ((pushforward f).obj M) ≫
          moduleBaseChangeMap f f' g p h M ≫
          (pushforward f').map
            (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction p)).leftAdjointUniq
              (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p)).hom.app M)) ≫
      canonicalSingleDirectImageMap f' ((pullback p).obj M)
